achievements.summary: Hold at least 7 Red Heart Containers at one time.

steps.text: Pick up Red Heart Containers until you hold 7 or more at once.

achievements.summary: Hold at least 55 Coins at one time.

steps.text: Save up Coins until you are carrying 55 or more at once.

guide.context: Sheol sits below the Womb and opens through the trapdoor in the Devil Room after Mom's Heart; once It Lives! is unlocked and defeated, the trapdoor always appears.

steps.text: Reach Sheol and defeat Satan.
Reach the end of the Depths and defeat Mom.
Reach the end of the Depths and defeat Mom.
steps.note: This unlocks Famine, Pestilence, War, and Death as bosses that can replace floor bosses.

steps.text: Reach the end of the Depths and defeat Mom.
steps.note: This unlocks the Cube of Meat, a passive orbital familiar.

guide.context: After the first Mom kill, a floor's boss has a 10% chance to be a Harbinger unless that floor has a fixed boss.

steps.text: Play until a Harbinger replaces a floor boss, then defeat it.
steps.note: Famine is the Chapter 1 Harbinger, Pestilence Chapter 2, War Chapter 3, and Death Chapter 4.

steps.text: Defeat Mom's Heart at the end of the Womb 3 times.
steps.note: The count carries across runs.

achievements.summary: Complete the Boss Rush as Azazel.

steps.text: Unlock Azazel by making 3 Deals with the Devil in a single run.
Defeat Mom in the Depths within 20 minutes, then enter the Boss Rush door.
Clear all 15 waves as Azazel.
steps.note: Each wave has 2 bosses, and the next wave starts only after both are dead.

steps.text: Defeat Mom's Heart at the end of the Womb 8 times.
steps.note: The count carries across runs.

steps.text: Defeat Mom's Heart at the end of the Womb 9 times.
steps.note: The count carries across runs.

guide.context: Tinted Rocks are marked with an X and are destroyed with bombs; only one can spawn per room.

steps.text: Blow up Tinted Rocks with bombs, 100 in total across any number of runs.
steps.note: In the Womb, Utero, and Scarred Womb they match the surrounding rocks, so check the lower right for the X.

steps.text: Defeat the boss at the end of the Basement.
Defeat the boss at the end of the Caves.

achievements.summary: Defeat Lokii in the Womb or Utero.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 4 and defeat Lokii.
steps.note: Lokii fights as two Loki halves in one room.

steps.text: Defeat the Basement's boss 40 times across runs.
Defeat the Caves' boss 30 times across runs.
Defeat the Depths' boss 20 times across runs.

achievements.summary: Create a Super Bandage Girl by collecting four Ball of Bandages in one run.

guide.context: The first Harbinger you kill decides the familiar drop for the whole run; later Harbingers drop the same one, never the other.

steps.text: Restart runs until The Book of Revelations appears in the Basement's Treasure Room or Library.
steps.note: The Book is the reward for defeating a Harbinger, so unlock it first.

steps.text: Use the Book on each chapter to make its Harbinger the floor boss.
steps.note: Famine appears in Chapter 1, Pestilence in Chapter 2, War in Chapter 3, and Death in Chapter 4; War cannot appear on Depths II and Death cannot appear on Womb II.

steps.text: Pick up each Ball of Bandages; the fourth copy completes the Super Bandage Girl.
steps.note: Headless Horseman can take a Harbinger's place and drops A Pony instead of a familiar, ending the run's drop chain.

achievements.summary: Defeat Isaac in the Cathedral as Magdalene.

guide.context: The Cathedral is reached through the beam of light that appears after Mom's Heart.

steps.text: Unlock Magdalene by holding at least 7 Red Heart Containers.
Take the beam of light up to the Cathedral and defeat Isaac as Magdalene.

achievements.summary: Defeat Isaac in the Cathedral as Cain.

guide.context: The Cathedral is reached through the beam of light that appears after Mom's Heart.

steps.text: Unlock Cain by carrying 55 or more Coins at once.

guide.context: The Sins are Envy, Gluttony, Wrath, Pride, Lust, Greed, and Sloth, and they appear in Mini-Boss rooms on any floor except the Chest and Dark Room.

steps.text: Defeat each of the seven Sins across runs.
steps.note: A Mini-Boss room has no special door and boards up while you fight.

steps.text: Reach the Depths and defeat Gish in a boss room.
steps.note: Gish is much rarer than the Depths' other bosses and also appears in the Dank Depths.

steps.text: Reach the Basement and defeat Steven in a boss room.
Reach the Caves and defeat C.H.A.D. in a boss room.
steps.note: If your first C.H.A.D. kill is as Tainted Lost, the achievement will not unlock.

guide.context: Arcades only appear on even-numbered floors when you leave the previous floor holding 5 or more coins, and they cost 1 coin to open.

steps.text: Enter an Arcade 10 times across runs.
steps.note: Carrying 2 or more keys can turn the room into a Vault instead.

achievements.summary: Beat Mom, Mom's Heart, or It Lives! with The Bible.

guide.context: The Bible instantly kills Mom, Mom's Heart, and It Lives! when used during their fights.

steps.text: Pick up The Bible during a run.

achievements.summary: Use the XIII - Death card 4 times.

guide.context: XIII - Death deals 40 damage to every enemy in the room, the same effect as The Necronomicon.

guide.context: Donations carry over between runs, but the machine jams with a 5% chance per coin and stays jammed until the next run. The machine appears in almost every Shop.

steps.note: Do not bomb the machine: exploding it lowers the saved total, and destroying it stops it from appearing again that run.

guide.context: In this challenge the chapters run in reverse order, and every floor you ascend removes one item and one Red Heart container.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Backasswards} from the challenge list and finish the run.

guide.context: Every boss in the challenge is @enemy{The Bloat}, item pedestals and pickups are disguised, and active item, pill, card, and rune effects are randomized.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Aprils Fool} from the challenge list and defeat @enemy{Mom}.

guide.context: The challenge starts you with @item{Friendly Ball} and @item{Mom's Eyeshadow}; each @item{Friendly Ball} use spawns a random monster, and killing that monster instantly recharges the ball.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Pokey Mans} from the challenge list and finish the run.

guide.context: All enemies spawn as champions when possible, boss fights are doubled when possible, and no heart pickups drop.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Ultra Hard} from the challenge list and finish the run.

guide.context: Damage is fixed at 100 and you start with @item{Cupid's Arrow} and @item{Rubber Cement}.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Pong} from the challenge list and finish the run.

achievements.summary: Win five Daily Challenges in a row.

guide.context: The wins do not need to be on consecutive days; only the daily runs you play are counted.

steps.text: Play a Daily Challenge each day and win until you have five wins in a row.

achievements.summary: Complete three Victory Laps, beating The Lamb each time.

guide.context: Each lap starts from the option offered after The Lamb dies in the @loc{Dark Room}; on the third lap your character becomes @npc{The Lost}.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{The Lamb} in the @loc{Dark Room} and start the @mechanic{Victory Lap} when offered.
Reach the @loc{Dark Room} again and beat @enemy{The Lamb} to finish the lap.
Repeat for a second and third lap to unlock the @mechanic{RERUN} power.

guide.context: @enemy{Delirium} sits in a 2x2 boss room in @loc{The Void}; a boss room that could not fit a 2x2 shape cannot contain it.

steps.text: Reach @loc{The Void} through a portal after a major boss, or defeat @enemy{Hush} for a guaranteed entrance.
Clear the floor's boss rooms and defeat @enemy{Delirium} when you find it.

achievements.summary: Reach 1000000% by collecting every item, completing the Bestiary, and unlocking all secrets and endings.

guide.context: The save file's practical targets are at least 510 entries in the collection page and 402 unlocked achievements.

steps.text: Fill the collection page and the Bestiary with every item and enemy entry.
Unlock all remaining secrets and endings.

achievements.summary: Defeat Mega Satan to unlock Apollyon.

guide.context: Mega Satan waits behind the golden door in the first room of the @loc{Chest} or @loc{Dark Room}; the door opens with both @item{Key Pieces} from the @enemy{Angels}.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Chest} or @loc{Dark Room}.
Collect both @item{Key Pieces} from the @enemy{Angels}, open the golden door, and defeat @enemy{Mega Satan}.

achievements.summary: Deposit 500 coins in the Greed Donation Machine to unlock Greedier mode.

guide.context: The @item{Greed Donation Machine} appears in @mechanic{Greed mode} after @enemy{Ultra Greed} is defeated; Greedier mode is the reward at 500 donated coins.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Ultra Greed} in @mechanic{Greed mode}.
Donate your leftover coins to the @item{Greed Donation Machine} after the fight until the total reaches 500.

achievements.summary: Defeat Mom's Heart 11 times to unlock the Burning Basement.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Mom's Heart} 11 times across your runs.

achievements.summary: Defeat Mom's Heart or It Lives! a total of 16 times to unlock the Flooded Caves.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Mom's Heart} or @enemy{It Lives!} a total of 16 times across your runs.

achievements.summary: Defeat Mom's Heart or It Lives! a total of 21 times to unlock the Dank Depths.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Mom's Heart} or @enemy{It Lives!} a total of 21 times across your runs.

achievements.summary: Defeat Mom's Heart or It Lives! a total of 30 times to unlock the Scarred Womb.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Mom's Heart} or @enemy{It Lives!} a total of 30 times across your runs.

achievements.summary: Defeat ??? as three different characters to unlock new bosses.

steps.text: Clear the @loc{Chest} and defeat @enemy{???} with three different characters.

achievements.summary: Defeat ??? as six different characters to unlock more bosses.

steps.text: Clear the @loc{Chest} and defeat @enemy{???} with six different characters.
Reach @loc{Sheol} and defeat @enemy{Satan} while carrying @item{The Negative}.
steps.note: The Negative drops from Mom once unlocked; without it the Dark Room can still be reached from a Sacrifice Room.

steps.text: Touch the chest to enter the @loc{Dark Room} and defeat @enemy{The Lamb}.

guide.context: Portals appear in @loc{The Void} and keep releasing enemies until they are destroyed.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Hush} to unlock @loc{The Void}, then jump into the portal that opens in the Hush room.
steps.note: After the first Hush kill, portals can also appear after other major bosses.

steps.text: Kill 20 @enemy{Portals} across Void runs.
Destroy 500 rocks across runs.
steps.note: Bombs and explosions are the usual way to break rocks.

guide.context: Chapter 1 covers the @loc{Basement} and its alternate stages. Devil Deals, Blood Donation Machines, and Health Down pills do not count as damage; enemy hits, spikes, bombs, and Curse Room spikes do.

steps.text: Clear both Chapter 1 floors without being hit.
steps.note: The achievement triggers when the second floor's boss dies.

guide.context: The transformation triggers after picking up 3 items that carry the game's fly tag.

steps.text: Collect 3 fly-tagged items in one run, such as @item{Jar of Flies} or @item{???'s Only Friend}.
steps.note: Beelzebub grants flight and turns several fly enemies into Blue Flies.

steps.text: Destroy 5 rainbow poops across runs.
steps.note: Like other poops, they break from tears, explosions, or stomping effects.

achievements.summary: Finish 7 Daily Challenges, touching the trophy at the end of each run.

guide.context: Daily runs are one-shot: you get a single scored attempt per day, and leaving the run ends it.

steps.text: Play the @loc{Daily Challenge} on 7 different days.
Beat each day's goal and touch the trophy at the end.
Pick up 5 familiar items in a single run.
steps.note: Any companion item counts, including orbitals and shooting familiars.

guide.context: Little Horn is a possible boss in every Chapter 1 environment: @loc{Basement}, @loc{Cellar}, and @loc{Burning Basement}.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Little Horn} whenever he appears as a Chapter 1 boss.
Keep clearing Chapter 1 runs until 20 kills are logged.

achievements.summary: Defeat Delirium for the first time.

guide.context: Delirium waits inside @loc{The Void}, a chapter unlocked by defeating @enemy{Hush}.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Hush} once to unlock @loc{The Void}.
Enter the portal that appears after a major boss and defeat @enemy{Delirium}.
steps.note: After the first Hush kill, a portal can also spawn after other major bosses.

achievements.summary: Recharge an active item with Lil' Batteries 20 times.

guide.context: Lil' Batteries are battery pickups that add charges to the active item Isaac is holding.

steps.text: Pick up 20 @item{Lil' Batteries} while carrying an active item.
steps.note: Shops are a reliable source.

guide.context: Bedrooms appear on Chapters 1-3, are more common while Isaac is hurt, and sit behind a double-plank door that takes two bombs to open.

steps.text: Open a @loc{Bedroom}'s plank door and sleep in the bed.
steps.note: The sleep sequence only starts if Isaac is missing health.

achievements.summary: Complete 2 Victory Laps, defeating The Lamb at the end of each.

guide.context: A Victory Lap begins after The Lamb dies in the @loc{Dark Room}. You can keep lapping as long as the Dark Room is cleared each time, and @item{The Negative} may need to be picked up again.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{The Lamb} in the @loc{Dark Room} and start a @mechanic{Victory Lap}.
Clear the @loc{Dark Room} again and defeat @enemy{The Lamb} to finish the first lap.
Start a second lap and defeat @enemy{The Lamb} once more.

achievements.summary: Grow Isaac to 3 times his starting size in one run.

guide.context: Size increases come from certain items, cards, and pills; depending on their multipliers, 5 to 7 increases may be needed.

steps.text: Collect size-increasing items, cards, or pills in a single run until Isaac is 3 times larger than at the start.
Activate 20 cards or runes across runs.

achievements.summary: Add Broken Watch and Stop Watch to Isaac's collection.

steps.text: Pick up @item{Broken Watch} and @item{Stop Watch} in any runs.
steps.note: Collection credit is permanent, so they do not need to be found in the same run.

achievements.summary: Make 50 purchases from Shops, Devil Rooms, or Black Markets.

steps.text: Buy or take items from @loc{Shops}, @loc{Devil Rooms}, and @loc{Black Markets} until 50 purchases are made.

guide.context: Chapter 2 covers the @loc{Caves} and its alternate stages. Devil Deals, Blood Donation Machines, and Health Down pills do not count as damage; enemy hits, spikes, bombs, and Curse Room spikes do.

steps.text: Clear both Chapter 2 floors without being hit.
steps.note: The achievement triggers when the second floor's boss dies.

achievements.summary: Use Pandora's Box in the Dark Room.

steps.text: Carry @item{Pandora's Box} to the @loc{Dark Room} and activate it there.

achievements.summary: Collect 2 battery-tagged items in one run.

guide.context: The battery tag covers @item{9 Volt}, @item{Car Battery}, and @item{The Battery}.

steps.text: Pick up any 2 of those items during a single run.

guide.context: Chapter 3 covers the @loc{Depths} and its alternate stages. Devil Deals, Blood Donation Machines, and Health Down pills do not count as damage; enemy hits, spikes, bombs, and Curse Room spikes do.

steps.text: Clear both Chapter 3 floors without being hit.
steps.note: The achievement triggers when the second floor's boss dies.

achievements.summary: Collect 2 tech-tagged items in one run.

guide.context: Technology-related items carry the game's tech tag.

steps.text: Pick up 2 technology-related items during a single run.

achievements.summary: Gather Key Pieces 1 and 2 during one run.

guide.context: Key Pieces drop from the Angel that appears when an Angel Statue is bombed in an Angel Room.

steps.text: Bomb an @mechanic{Angel Statue} in an Angel Room and defeat the summoned @enemy{Angel} for the first Key Piece.
Find a second Angel later in the same run and take the other Key Piece.
steps.note: If two statues appear in one room, fight them one at a time or only one Key Piece will drop.

steps.text: Open 20 @item{Locked Chests} across runs.
steps.note: Locked Chests need a Key, or the @item{Paper Clip} trinket.

guide.context: The five Harbingers are Famine, Pestilence, War, Death, and Conquest. A floor boss is a Harbinger 10% of the time by default, Conquest only appears after 10 Angel Room items have been taken, and War and Death cannot appear on the second floor of their chapters.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Famine}, @enemy{Pestilence}, @enemy{War}, @enemy{Death}, and @enemy{Conquest} across runs.
steps.note: Using @item{Book of Revelations} on a floor guarantees a Harbinger boss.

guide.context: Angels are summoned by bombing the statue inside an Angel Room.

steps.text: Bomb the @mechanic{Angel Statue} whenever you find one and defeat the @enemy{Angel}.
Repeat across runs until 10 Angels are defeated.

guide.context: Chapter 4 covers the @loc{Womb} and its alternate stages. Devil Deals, Blood Donation Machines, and Health Down pills do not count as damage; enemy hits, spikes, bombs, and Curse Room spikes do.

steps.text: Clear both Chapter 4 floors without being hit, including the @enemy{Mom's Heart} or @enemy{It Lives!} fight.
steps.note: The achievement triggers when the final boss dies.

achievements.summary: Blow up 50 doors or Secret Room walls.

steps.text: Use bombs on 50 doors and @loc{Secret Room} walls.
Take items from @loc{Devil Rooms} until 25 deals are made across runs.
Pick up the @item{Blood Clot} item 10 times across runs.

achievements.summary: Obtain 10 Tears Up items or pills during a single run.

guide.context: Only items and pills with the Tears Up effect count; losing the stat later does not subtract from the total.

steps.text: Take every Tears Up item and pill you find in one run.
steps.note: Dropping or rerolling a Tears Up item does not undo the credit.

steps.text: Visit 6 @loc{Shops} during a single run.

guide.context: Angel Room items are free, but taking one makes the other items in the room disappear, and taking a Devil Deal stops Angel Rooms from appearing.

steps.text: Take the item every time you enter an @loc{Angel Room} until 25 are collected.

achievements.summary: Put Car Battery, 9 Volt, and The Battery in Isaac's collection.

steps.text: Pick up @item{Car Battery}, @item{9 Volt}, and @item{The Battery} in any runs.
steps.note: Collection credit is permanent, so the three do not need to be found together.

steps.text: Take items from @loc{Devil Rooms} until 50 deals are made across runs.

achievements.summary: Kill Isaac with his own explosion while using an explosive, poisoned tear source.

guide.context: The qualifying sources are Ipecac, Bob's Rotten Head, Fire Mind or Explosivo paired with Scorpio, or a Horf! pill.

steps.text: Gather one of those explosive and poison sources.
Shoot a wall or enemy at close range until the blast kills Isaac.

guide.context: Bedrooms appear on Chapters 1-3, are more common while Isaac is hurt, and sit behind a double-plank door that takes two bombs to open.

steps.text: Sleep in 10 @loc{Bedroom} beds across runs.
steps.note: The sleep sequence only starts if Isaac is missing health.

achievements.summary: Swallow 5 Gulp! pills during one run.

guide.context: Uses of @item{Placebo} loaded with a Gulp! pill also count.

steps.text: Use @item{Gulp!} pills 5 times in a single run.
steps.note: Placebo copies a pill's effect and its uses count toward the total.

achievements.summary: Get 20 Blue Flies alive at once.

guide.context: Blue Flies come from fly items, the @mechanic{Guppy} transformation, Rotten Hearts, and the @item{Friends Till The End!} pill.

steps.text: Build a fly-heavy run and keep summoning @mechanic{Blue Flies} until 20 are alive at the same time.

achievements.summary: With homing tears already active, use the I - The Magician card or the Telepathy For Dummies item.

steps.text: Pick up an item that grants homing tears.
Then play the @item{I - The Magician} card or activate @item{Telepathy For Dummies} while the homing effect is active.

achievements.summary: Unlock The Forgotten by using Mom's Shovel on the Dirt Patch in the Dark Room's Grave Room.

guide.context: The first shovel piece appears only if The Lamb has been defeated at least once, and RERUN or Victory Lap runs cannot unlock The Forgotten.

steps.text: Start an unseeded run and beat the first floor's boss in under a minute.
Bomb the starting room floor to spawn the first @item{Broken Shovel} piece.
steps.note: While you carry it, Mom stomps the floor; the Boss Rush time limit is lifted and the Womb entrance stays sealed until Boss Rush is done.

steps.text: Take the Broken Shovel into @loc{Boss Rush} and finish every wave to assemble @item{Mom's Shovel}.
With the shovel in hand, only @item{The Negative} appears after Mom; take it and ride the trapdoor down to @loc{Sheol}.
Defeat @enemy{Satan} and touch the chest to enter the @loc{Dark Room}.
Stand on the @loc{Dirt Patch} in the @loc{Grave Room} and use Mom's Shovel.
steps.note: Leaving the Grave Room before the cutscene's soul reaches the top can prevent the unlock.

achievements.summary: Unlock The Forgotten to add the Bone Heart pickup to the game.

steps.text: Beat the first boss of the run in under a minute, then bomb the starting room for the first @item{Broken Shovel} piece.
Finish @loc{Boss Rush} while holding the Broken Shovel to assemble @item{Mom's Shovel}.
Use Mom's Shovel on the @loc{Dirt Patch} in the @loc{Dark Room}'s Grave Room.
steps.note: The Bone Heart unlocks together with The Forgotten.

achievements.summary: On Hard mode, defeat It Lives! or Mom's Heart while playing The Forgotten.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{Hard mode} run as @npc{The Forgotten}.
Reach the @loc{Womb} and defeat @enemy{It Lives!} or @enemy{Mom's Heart}.

guide.context: Isaac is always the boss of the @loc{Cathedral}; the beam of light up to it always appears after @enemy{It Lives!} is defeated.

steps.text: Start a run as @npc{The Forgotten} and defeat @enemy{It Lives!} or @enemy{Mom's Heart}.
Ride the beam of light up to the @loc{Cathedral} and defeat @enemy{Isaac}.

guide.context: Satan is always the boss of @loc{Sheol}, reached through the trapdoor below the @loc{Womb}.

steps.text: Start a run as @npc{The Forgotten} and defeat @enemy{It Lives!} or @enemy{Mom's Heart}.
Descend through the trapdoor to @loc{Sheol} and defeat @enemy{Satan}.

guide.context: ??? is always the boss of the @loc{Chest}, which opens by touching the chest that drops after beating Isaac in the Cathedral while holding @item{The Polaroid}.

steps.text: As @npc{The Forgotten}, beat @enemy{Isaac} in the @loc{Cathedral} while carrying @item{The Polaroid}.
Touch the chest to enter the @loc{Chest} and defeat @enemy{???}.

achievements.summary: Defeat The Lamb as The Forgotten.

guide.context: The Lamb is always the boss of the @loc{Dark Room}, entered by touching the chest that drops after beating Satan in Sheol while holding @item{The Negative}.

steps.text: As @npc{The Forgotten}, beat @enemy{Satan} in @loc{Sheol} while carrying @item{The Negative}.
Touch the chest to enter the @loc{Dark Room} and defeat @enemy{The Lamb}.

achievements.summary: Clear Boss Rush as The Forgotten.

guide.context: Boss Rush opens when Mom is defeated within 20 minutes, and it runs for 15 waves of two bosses.

steps.text: Start as @npc{The Forgotten} and defeat @enemy{Mom} within 20 minutes.
Enter @loc{Boss Rush}, pick up one of the starting items, and clear all 15 waves.

guide.context: Hush is the boss of @loc{Blue Womb}, a floor unlocked by defeating Mom's Heart 10 times; its entrance appears when Mom's Heart or It Lives! is beaten within 30 minutes.

steps.text: Start as @npc{The Forgotten} and beat @enemy{It Lives!} or @enemy{Mom's Heart} in under 30 minutes.
Enter the @loc{Blue Womb} and defeat @enemy{Hush}.

achievements.summary: Defeat Ultra Greed as The Forgotten.

guide.context: This unlock happens in @mechanic{Greed mode}'s final boss room; @npc{The Forgotten} must be unlocked as a character before he can be selected.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{Greed mode} run as @npc{The Forgotten} and clear the mode's seven floors.
In the last room, defeat @enemy{Ultra Greed}.
steps.note: When he falls, Ultra Greed drops the final boss chest and the Greed Donation Machine.

achievements.summary: Defeat Ultra Greedier as The Forgotten.

guide.context: Ultra Greedier is the second phase of the @mechanic{Greedier mode} final boss; Greedier mode unlocks once the Greed Donation Machine has collected 500 coins.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Greedier mode} as @npc{The Forgotten} and reach the final floor.
Defeat @enemy{Ultra Greed}, then beat his @enemy{Ultra Greedier} phase.

guide.context: @loc{The Void}'s main boss is @enemy{Delirium}; the floor opens after your first Hush kill, and later portals can also appear after major bosses.

steps.text: Reach @loc{The Void} as @npc{The Forgotten} through a portal.
steps.note: The first portal opens in @enemy{Hush}'s room once Hush is defeated.

steps.text: Find the boss room holding @enemy{Delirium} and defeat him.

achievements.summary: Complete every Hard-mode completion mark as The Forgotten.

guide.context: The marks cover Mom's Heart or It Lives!, then Isaac, ???, Satan, The Lamb, Mega Satan, Boss Rush, Hush, Ultra Greed, Ultra Greedier, Delirium, Mother, and The Beast; Hard clears also fill the Normal marks.

steps.text: As @npc{The Forgotten}, defeat every completion-mark boss on @mechanic{Hard mode} across runs.
steps.note: The Greed and Greedier marks come from @mechanic{Greed mode} and @mechanic{Greedier mode}.

achievements.summary: Defeat Mega Satan as The Forgotten.

guide.context: Mega Satan waits behind the Golden Gate that seals the starting rooms in the @loc{Chest} and @loc{Dark Room}; the gate appears after ??? or The Lamb has been defeated and opens with both Key Pieces or @item{Dad's Key}.

steps.text: As @npc{The Forgotten}, reach the @loc{Chest} or @loc{Dark Room} carrying a way to open the Golden Gate.
steps.note: Key Pieces drop from Uriel and Gabriel; bomb an Angel Statue or use a Sacrifice Room's 9th and 11th spike steps to summon them.

steps.text: Pass the gate, step on the pentagram, and defeat @enemy{Mega Satan}.
Pick up @item{Rubber Cement} five times.

achievements.summary: Get 3 charmed enemies into the same room at once.

guide.context: Charmed allies follow Isaac between rooms and keep fighting until they die, so they can be gathered one at a time.

steps.text: Throw @item{Friendly Ball} at a normal enemy to capture it, then throw again to release it as a charmed ally.
Capture and release two more enemies, then gather all three in one room.
steps.note: @item{Book of the Dead} can also produce charmed Bonies once enemies have died in the room.

achievements.description: Beat Hard mode as Lazarus without losing a life
achievements.summary: Unlock Bethany by beating It Lives! or Mom's Heart as Lazarus on Hard mode without dying once.

guide.context: Dying voids the unlock even though Lazarus can revive; a run finished as Lazarus Risen cannot unlock Bethany.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{Hard mode} run as @npc{Lazarus}.
Reach the @loc{Womb} and defeat @enemy{It Lives!} or @enemy{Mom's Heart} without dying once.

achievements.description: You are just like your father...
achievements.summary: Defeat Mother to unlock Jacob and Esau.

guide.context: Mother waits in @loc{Corpse} II at the end of the alternate path, which unlocks once @enemy{Hush} has been defeated 3 times.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Hush} 3 times to unlock the alt-path doors.
Take @item{Knife Piece 1} from @loc{Downpour} II's Mirrored World, then @item{Knife Piece 2} in @loc{Mines} II.
In @loc{Mausoleum} II, defeat @enemy{Mom}, then stab the flesh door with the assembled knife.
steps.note: A @item{Sharp Key}, @item{Cracked Orb}, or Soul of Cain can open it instead.

steps.text: Beat the stronger @enemy{Mom's Heart} behind the door so the @loc{Womb} trapdoor leads to the @loc{Corpse}.
steps.note: Items left on the floor vanish once this Mom's Heart dies.

steps.text: Drop through the hole in @loc{Corpse} II's boss room and defeat @enemy{Mother}.

achievements.summary: Collect 3 items carrying the 'stars' tag during one run.

guide.context: The 'stars' tag marks astrology items; all three must be held at once, and items dropped or lost to effects such as the D4 stop counting.

steps.text: Pick up 3 items tagged 'stars' during one run.
steps.note: @item{Crystal Ball} and @item{Deck of Cards} count only while held.

guide.context: Hush guards @loc{???} (Blue Womb), which unlocks after 10 Mom's Heart kills and opens when @enemy{It Lives!} or @enemy{Mom's Heart} is beaten within 30 minutes.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{It Lives!} or @enemy{Mom's Heart} in under 30 minutes to open @loc{???}.
Enter @loc{???} and defeat @enemy{Hush}.
steps.note: Progress carries over between runs and also unlocks the @loc{Corpse} and the alternate floors.

achievements.description: Get that song out of her head.
achievements.summary: Destroy The Siren's skull after beating her to unlock the Forgotten Lullaby.

guide.context: @enemy{The Siren} is a @loc{Mausoleum} boss; her skull only spawns the item the first time it is bombed, and it disappears if you leave the room and return.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Mausoleum} and defeat @enemy{The Siren}.
Bomb the skull she leaves behind before leaving the room.

guide.context: @enemy{Baby Plum} appears in Chapter 1 boss pools once she is unlocked by defeating ??? as 6 different characters.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Baby Plum} whenever she appears in @loc{Basement}, @loc{Cellar}, or @loc{Burning Basement}.
steps.note: Hit her at least once every 30 seconds or she flees and the kill does not count.

steps.text: Repeat across runs until 10 kills are logged.

achievements.summary: Let Baby Plum escape instead of defeating her.

guide.context: She flies off after 30 seconds without taking damage; a hit resets that timer without cancelling the escape, and this only works in her own boss room outside @mechanic{Greed mode}.

steps.text: Find @enemy{Baby Plum} in a Chapter 1 boss room and avoid damaging her for 30 seconds.
steps.note: She waves and flees, and the room's boss item is replaced by @item{Plum Flute}.

achievements.summary: Reach the Corpse for the first time.

guide.context: The @loc{Corpse} is the alternate @loc{Womb}, reached after the alternate @loc{Mausoleum} II Mom fight once the alt path is unlocked.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Hush} 3 times to unlock the alt-path doors.
Take @item{Knife Piece 1} from @loc{Downpour} II's Mirrored World, then @item{Knife Piece 2} in @loc{Mines} II.
In @loc{Mausoleum} II, defeat @enemy{Mom} and stab the flesh door with the assembled knife familiar.
steps.note: A @item{Sharp Key}, a @item{Cracked Orb}, or Soul of Cain works too.

steps.text: Defeat the stronger @enemy{Mom's Heart} behind the door, then take the @loc{Womb} trapdoor down to the @loc{Corpse}.

guide.context: The @loc{Downpour} bosses are @enemy{Lil Blub}, @enemy{Wormwood}, @enemy{The Rainmaker}, and @enemy{Min-Min}; beating them all unlocks @loc{Dross}. The alt floor unlocks after @enemy{Hush} falls 3 times.

steps.text: Take the locked @loc{Downpour} door that appears after a Chapter 1 boss.
steps.note: The door needs a key.

steps.text: Defeat whichever of @enemy{Lil Blub}, @enemy{Wormwood}, @enemy{The Rainmaker}, and @enemy{Min-Min} you meet.
Run Downpour until all four bosses have been defeated.

achievements.description: Defeat all bosses in the Mines.
achievements.summary: Defeat every boss in the Mines.

guide.context: The @loc{Mines} bosses are @enemy{Reap Creep}, @enemy{Tuff Twins}, @enemy{Great Gideon}, and @enemy{Hornfel}; clearing them all unlocks @loc{Ashpit}. The alt floor unlocks after @enemy{Hush} falls 3 times.

steps.text: Open the boarded Mines door with 2 bombs after the Caves boss.
steps.note: It can also be entered at the end of @loc{Downpour} or @loc{Dross}.

steps.text: Defeat whichever of @enemy{Reap Creep}, @enemy{Tuff Twins}, @enemy{Great Gideon}, and @enemy{Hornfel} you meet.
Run Mines until all four bosses have been defeated.

achievements.description: Defeat all bosses in the Mausoleum.
achievements.summary: Defeat every boss in the Mausoleum.

guide.context: The Mausoleum's only unique bosses are @enemy{The Siren} and @enemy{The Heretic}; a @mechanic{Boss Challenge room} on @mechanic{Hard mode} can spawn both in one run.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Mausoleum} by paying two full hearts at its door.
steps.note: The door appears after the Mines/Ashpit II boss or after Depths I, Necropolis I, or Dank Depths I.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{The Siren} and @enemy{The Heretic} whenever they show up.

steps.text: Unlock @npc{Tainted Isaac} by touching the figure in @loc{Home}'s hidden closet, which opens when a @item{Red Key}, a @item{Cracked Key}, or a @item{Soul of Cain} is used in the hallway outside Mom's bedroom.

steps.text: Take the beam of light after @enemy{Mom's Heart} or @enemy{It Lives!} to the @loc{Cathedral}, defeat @enemy{Isaac}, then touch the chest he leaves and defeat @enemy{???} in the @loc{Chest}.

guide.context: Mother is the boss of @loc{Corpse} II, the alternative Womb floor. The route follows the alt path through @loc{Downpour}, @loc{Mines}, and @loc{Mausoleum}, and the Corpse entrance replaces the Womb trapdoor once the stronger Mausoleum @enemy{Mom's Heart} is beaten.

steps.text: Unlock @npc{Tainted Isaac} by touching the figure in @loc{Home}'s hidden closet, which opens when a @item{Red Key}, a @item{Cracked Key}, or a @item{Soul of Cain} is used in the hallway outside Mom's bedroom.

steps.note: Touch the @mechanic{White Fire Place} to turn into a ghost and walk into the mirror room's mirror; the Downpour door needs a key.

steps.text: Open the boarded @loc{Mines} door after the @loc{Downpour} II boss with 2 bombs, then in @loc{Mines} II press the three @mechanic{Yellow Buttons} on the floor to repair the track and ride the minecart to @item{Knife Piece 2}.
steps.note: One button is in the minecart room and the other two are elsewhere on the floor. With flight, fly to the boarded door at the end of the track and blow it open with 2 bombs instead.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Mausoleum} through the door after the @loc{Mines} II boss.
steps.note: The Mausoleum door costs two full hearts and can also appear after @loc{Depths} I. The knife familiar needs both pieces.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Mom}, stab the flesh door with the knife familiar, and beat the stronger @enemy{Mom's Heart} behind it.

steps.text: Take @item{Knife Piece 1} from the Treasure Room of the @loc{Mirrored World} in @loc{Downpour II} by touching the white fire to turn into a ghost and walking through the mirror.
In @loc{Mines II}, press the three buttons that repair the broken minecart track and ride the minecart to @item{Knife Piece 2}.
Enter the @loc{Mausoleum} through the door that appears after @loc{Mines II}'s boss.
steps.note: The door costs two full hearts, or opens with @item{Dad's Key} or a @item{Sharp Key}.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Mom} in @loc{Mausoleum II} and fire the knife familiar at the flesh door.
Defeat the stronger @enemy{Mom's Heart}, then take the trapdoor that now leads to the @loc{Corpse}.
In @loc{Corpse II}, drop into the hole in the boss room and defeat @enemy{Mother}.

achievements.summary: Earn every Hard mode Completion Mark for all characters, including the tainted ones.

guide.context: Hard mode clears fill the matching Normal mode mark as well, and the tainted characters track their own separate notes.

steps.text: Play every route on @mechanic{Hard mode} with all 34 characters, including the tainted versions.
steps.note: Each character's note needs the @enemy{Mom's Heart} or @enemy{It Lives!} fights, then @enemy{Isaac}, @enemy{???}, @enemy{Satan}, @enemy{The Lamb}, and @enemy{Mega Satan}, plus @loc{Boss Rush}, @enemy{Hush}, @enemy{Delirium}, @enemy{Mother}, and @enemy{The Beast}.

steps.text: Clear @mechanic{Greed mode} and @mechanic{Greedier mode} with every character, defeating @enemy{Ultra Greed} and @enemy{Ultra Greedier}.

achievements.description: Unlock every other achievement and collect every item in the game.
achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement, including the four added in Repentance+, then collect every item in the game.

steps.text: Earn every other achievement, including the four Repentance+ ones.
Collect every item in the game.

guide.context: Online play is a Repentance+ PC mode built on co-op rules, and achievements stay enabled as long as you join before the run begins.

steps.text: Start an Online game with a friend or a random player.
steps.note: Quick Match, Public Match, and Friend Match are the available pairings.

guide.context: Online play is a Repentance+ PC mode built on co-op rules, and joining a run that is already in progress disables its achievements.

steps.text: Finish an Online run with your team.

guide.context: Online Dailies are a Repentance+ match type that uses the day's fixed Daily run, which gives a set character, seed, end stage, and starting items.

steps.text: Start the Online Daily from the Online menu.
Win the day's run with your team.

achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Mom} to unlock in-game item descriptions.

steps.text: Reach the end of the @loc{Depths} and defeat @enemy{Mom}.
steps.note: Item descriptions are a Repentance+ feature.
